about: Official add-ons (core/official.py): published from addons/ in Kurooto's repository, each pinned to one commit. Shipped inside Kurooto, so a release's signature covers this list. A newer pinned commit goes in 'commit' (with 'tag'), and the one before it into 'earlier', so those who have it are offered the update.

addons.name: restic-backups
addons.title: Machine backups (restic)
addons.line: Backs up the folders you name with restic on a schedule, thins out old snapshots and checks the repository.
addons.needs: restic installed, and a restic repository (made once: /restic init after Set up)

addons.name: desktop-helpers
addons.title: Desktop helpers
addons.line: At the alarm, rings your phone through KDE Connect and wakes the screen; pings the phone for the kinds of messages you pick.
addons.needs: KDE Connect paired with your phone, or a Hyprland, Sway or X11 session

addons.name: habits
addons.title: Your command words
addons.line: Short words of your own for the commands and requests you type often: /j for /journal.

addons.name: handwriting-pull
addons.title: Handwriting from the cloud
addons.line: Copies new handwritten pages from a cloud folder with rclone into Handwritten notes' folder every 2 hours.
addons.needs: rclone set up with your cloud (rclone config), and Handwritten notes on

addons.name: night-performance
addons.title: Night performance
addons.line: Switches this computer to its highest performance power mode during Kurooto's heavy night work, and back when it's done.
addons.needs: power-profiles-daemon, tuned or asusctl (Linux), Windows' power plans, or your own commands; on a Lenovo Legion or LOQ, its helper (installed once with sudo)
